si_workflow.name: Complete CO2 Adsorption on Silicon Slab Workflow
si_workflow.description: Create a CO2 adsorbed structure on a Silicon slab. This involves: 1) Retrieving the Si bulk structure from Materials Project, 2) Enumerating possible slabs with Miller index (1,1,1), 3) Choosing a suitable slab, 4) Retrieving the CO2 molecule structure, 5) Identifying adsorption sites on the slab, 6) Choosing an appropriate adsorption site (preferably top), and 7) Adding the CO2 molecule to the slab at the chosen site with a height of approximately 2.0 Angstrom. Submit the path to the final combined structure CIF file.
